from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class IntangibleAssetsDisclosure(BaseModel):
    """Captures the reporting status and value of Intangible Assets for a specific fiscal year in a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as stated in the document")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the report covers, e.g., '2022'")
    intangible_assets_line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for Intangible Assets if present, or description of absence (e.g., 'Not reported separately')")
    intangible_assets_value: str | None = Field(description="The value reported for Intangible Assets, or 'N/A'/'None' if not reported")
    explicit_ip_statement: str | None = Field(description="Explicit statements about patents, trademarks, or IP ownership found in the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    disclosures: list[IntangibleAssetsDisclosure]
